description: 画一个 GPU 线程块的分层求和过程：四个 warp 各自产生一个 partial sum，分别写入共享缓冲的 s0、s1、s2、s3 四个槽。全块同步完成后，一个 warp 读取这些槽，先计算 s0+s1 和 s2+s3，再把两个结果相加，最后把 block sum 写入输出缓冲。希望突出数据如何从并行部分结果汇合到单个输出，barrier 只是允许读取的控制条件，不要把它当作执行加法的数据节点，也不指定周期数或 shuffle 指令实现。

spec.title: GPU Block Reduction: Warp Partials to Block Sum
spec.summary: 该图表达一个 GPU 线程块内的分层求和：四个 warp 各自产生 partial sum 并写入共享缓冲的 s0–s3 槽；全块 barrier 仅作为允许读取的控制条件；随后一个 warp 读取四个槽，先算 s0+s1 与 s2+s3，再相加得到 block sum 写入输出缓冲。图中不指定周期数，也不指定 shuffle 实现；barrier 不承担加法数据角色。

spec.layout: Left-to-right dominant flow. Top-left: g_warp with w0–w3 stacked vertically. Center: g_smem with s0–s3 aligned one-to-one with the warps, so each partial edge is a short horizontal arrow. Barrier sits between g_smem and g_reduce as a narrow vertical control band: arrive edges from warps route along the top corridor into barrier; a single dashed control edge from barrier to rd. Right: g_reduce with rd at left, add01 and add23 stacked in parallel, add_final below/right of them, then g_out with out at far right. Reading order: warps → slots → barrier → read → pairwise adds → final add → output.
steps: Each of the four warps computes its own partial sum.
Warp 0–3 write partials into s0–s3 of the shared buffer.
All warps reach the block barrier; only after full-block synchronization may the slots be read.
One warp reads s0, s1, s2, s3.
It computes s0+s1 and s2+s3 in parallel.
It adds the two results together.
The block sum is written to the output buffer.
annotations: Barrier is a control condition for read permission, not an adder and not a data operand.
No cycle counts or shuffle-based implementation is specified; the reduction is shown as explicit slot reads and adds.
assumptions: 补入各 warp 到 barrier 的 arrive 控制边，用于表达“全块同步完成后”这一前提；若原设计使用其他同步机制可替换。
s0–s3 与 Warp 0–3 的一一对应按写入顺序推定，属通用示意。
rd 节点表示归约 warp 的读取动作，其内部寄存器/加载细节未展开。
questions: 是否需要把归约 warp 的读取与两次加法展开为更细的寄存器级数据流？
是否需要在图中显式区分共享缓冲的写端口与读端口？
checks: 确认 barrier 只以控制边出现，未作为加法数据输入。
确认 s0+s1 与 s2+s3 为并行分支，且最终加法有两个输入。
确认图中未出现周期数或 shuffle 指令等未指定实现细节。
